title: The Dragon Demon Brand and Mu Chen's bet
summary: The dean and the three Elders of the Celestial Seat praise Mu Chen, then set up a formation to erase the Dragon Demon Brand the Black Dragon Sovereign planted on the Great Sumeru Demonic Pillar. The brand lets the Dragon Demon Palace descend; the Black Dragon Sovereign tries to blow up the formation and free the Pillar until Lord Beiming, the Northern Sea Dragon, freezes him and drives him off. The retreating Palace learns that Beiming is a ninth-grade Sovereign close to Earth Sovereign, and that Master Wuliang has agreed to work with them through the Holy Spiritual Academy, aiming at the Holy Spirit Mountain Trial in a month. Tai Cang explains that the trial's Holy Spirit Baptism helps geniuses survive the Three Sovereign Disasters, but refuses to send Mu Chen, who is only at the late phase of Heavenly Transformation. Mu Chen bets the dean and elders that he can reach Heavenly Completion within a month. Ling Xi finds their spiritual power resonates, begins pouring hers into him in her courtyard pool, and recovers a memory of being taken in as a beggar child by 'Aunt Jing', who gave her the Yin volume of the art and saved the Yang volume for her son.

changes: Guide: consistent. Adds Lord Beiming's intervention, the Wuliang alliance and the realm facts.
flags: 479/496 s: the Northern Sea Dragon is a ninth-grade Sovereign 'about to become an Earth Supreme Lord'. The roster has him as Earth Sovereign from EP54, which would put him backwards here; EP75 again says Ninth-Rank Supreme Lord, and EP80 (half a year later) calls him an Earth Sovereign. The EP54 roster entry is likely wrong, or he breaks through between EP79 and EP80.
508 s: the messenger who conveys Master Wuliang's promise is not named (Holy Spiritual Academy side).
588-591 s: 'geniuses advance smoothly until the late stage of the Completion of Heaven Level' is general, not a statement about anyone.
905 s: Ling Xi's line 'I finally... remember you' ends the flashback.
